notes.title: Will you be able to manage multiple stores at once?
notes.content:
Will you be able to manage multiple stores at once? And, on top of that, run an entire shopping mall? 
It’s a big challenge. 


Did you know that as your stores and customers grow, thieves will also start to appear? 

That’s where the Segway Security Team comes in to help. Yes, you heard that right! We’re adding that to the game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092980/MALL_MANAGER_SIMULATOR/

Plus, by popular request, we’re including gift card acceptance and unique uniforms for employees in each store. And so much more! Are you excited?

Add both games to your WISHLIST to stay updated on everything in time.
